decision: REQ-08 ships BOTH markdown audit doc (docs/decisions/governance-floors-audit.md) AND static RELAXATION_PATHS const + RelaxationPath type in luca-core; no new CLI verb, no Zod schema
alternatives: doc-only (not machine-checkable); const-only (no human audit); new luca floors CLI verb (3-registry trap)
reasoning: doc=human audit trail w/ confidence-gated-lu.md precedent; const=grep-checkable single-source; phase-05 anti-06 = no Zod for no-runtime-consumer const
risk: two artifacts drift; mitigated both grep-verified vs same source at authoring

decision: REQ-08 audit scope = PIPELINE gates only (stage-tool matrix, pipeline transitions, step-artifact allowlist, budget caps, bash classifier, confidence gate, rule/postmortem gates). EXCLUDE luca init/vault:init --skip-* flags (gate SETUP not pipeline); document the boundary explicitly in the doc
reasoning: init flags gate one-time setup, not the running pipeline; floors audit is about pipeline governance per REQ-08; stating the boundary prevents future re-litigation
risk: reader assumes init flags are unaudited bypass; mitigated by explicit excluded-scope section in doc

decision: skip-verify flag resolved as standalone-skill-only SOFT floor: /lu pipeline has NO skip-verify (verify is mandatory PIPELINE_TRANSITIONS step), but standalone /phase-plan exposes it at skills/phase-plan/index.ts:119. Document as standalone-only soft floor, not a pipeline bypass
alternatives: standalone flag exists); classify SOFT globally (wrong
reasoning: hard floor (pipeline verify step) has no flag; soft floor scoped to standalone skill only; no hidden pipeline-verify bypass exists
risk: reader conflates standalone flag w/ pipeline bypass; mitigated by explicit standalone-only annotation in doc and const source field

decision: REQ-09 trim removes over-prescription (ALL-CAPS banner stacking, redundant CRITICAL blocks, preachy rationale, Caveman-always-active line) but PRESERVES load-bearing tokens (criteria grammar ac-NN, deferred, verificationRef, doctrine refs, stage-gate/transition rules). agent-constraints.ts HARD_CONSTRAINTS untouched
alternatives: aggressive trim incl constraints (dominant risk = removes load-bearing governance mapping); no trim (fails REQ-09)
reasoning: directive-density is real noise; but constraints mapping to STAGE_TOOL_MATRIX/STEP_ARTIFACTS/doctrine are load-bearing; anti-criteria guard token survival via grep-count-unchanged probes
risk: over-trim drops a load-bearing constraint; mitigated by mandatory anti-criteria asserting token survival + agent-constraints.ts off-limits

decision: Enumerate skip-review/skip-uat/force-complex/gaps as soft RELAXATION_PATHS; classify tribunal/debate toggles + skip-verify-loop/skip-replay as explicitly-excluded non-floor enhancement/loop-control tokens in the doc sweep rather than const entries
alternatives: Add tribunal toggles as soft floors too (broader)
reasoning: Audit scope is governance FLOORS that gate enforced quality. skip-review/skip-uat truly skip gates. force-complex/gaps already documented. Tribunal toggles are COMPLEX+-only adversarial enhancements on top of base gates (default true), and skip-verify-loop/skip-replay are execution-loop controls (verify still always runs) — neither relaxes a floor, so they belong in the doc sweep as classified exclusions, keeping CLOSED honest.
risk: Reviewer may want tribunal toggles enumerated as soft floors; if so a follow-up adds them
reviewHint: Confirm tribunal/debate toggles are correctly classified as enhancements not floors

decision: Tribunal/debate toggles (verification_tribunal_enabled, tribunal_enabled, root_cause_tribunal_enabled, stall_debate_enabled) and loop controls (--skip-replay, --skip-verify-loop, --gaps-only, --quality-fixes, tdd/testable) classified as NON-floors (enhancements/loop-controls), excluded from RELAXATION_PATHS
alternatives: enumerate them as soft floors too
reasoning: they don't lower a governance floor — tribunals are COMPLEX+ quality enhancements (default on), loop controls govern re-execution not gate-skipping; verify/review/checks still run
risk: a reviewer may consider tribunal-disable a soft floor since it removes an adversarial check
